_about: Sourced reference values for plandscape.flora.species (session 3). Every value has a URL and a verbatim quote; metres converted from the source's units. Silvics = Burns & Honkala (1990), Agriculture Handbook 654; '#page=' is the PDF page. Fetched 2026-10-16. '[ft]' marks the scan's OCR misreading of 'ft'.
